name: Paracetamol (acetaminophen)
executiveSummary: Analgesic/antipyretic. Adult PO: **500–1000 mg every 6–8 h** (usual max **3 g/day**). IV: **1 g every 6 h**. Pediatric PO: **10–15 mg/kg/dose** (~**60 mg/kg/day**; not >**80 mg/kg/day** if <37 kg). Hepatotoxicity in overdose.
indications:
## Indications

- Fever and mild–moderate pain (PO or IV if oral not tolerated).

## Precautions

- Hepatotoxicity: do not combine multiple paracetamol products.
- Minimum interval **4 h**. Adjust in liver disease.
- Add **all routes** toward the daily ceiling.

> Check drops/suspension mg/mL before measuring.

adulto.presentation: PO: tabs 500–1000 mg; solution/drops. IV: 10 mg/mL (0.5–1 g bags).
adulto.dose: **PO**: **500–1000 mg every 6–8 h**; usual max **3 g/day** (up to **4 g/day** only inpatient without hepatic risk). **IV**: **1 g every 6 h** (if <50 kg: **15 mg/kg/dose**); max **3–4 g/day**; infusion **15 min**.
adulto.administration: PO with/without food. IV ready-to-use; no bolus.
adulto.notes: Count cold syrups and opioid combinations.

pediatrico.presentation: Drops 100 mg/mL; suspension ~32 mg/mL; IV 10 mg/mL.
pediatrico.dose: **PO**: **15 mg/kg every 6 h** or **10 mg/kg every 4 h** (~**60 mg/kg/day**; not >**80 mg/kg/day** if <37 kg). **IV**: **15 mg/kg/dose every 6 h**.

neonatal.dose: **PO or IV**: **10–15 mg/kg every 6–8 h** (longer intervals in preterms) — NNU card.

stability:
## Stability

- Orals per label. IV: after opening per insert; do not freeze.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Well tolerated at therapeutic doses. Nausea, rash. Overdose: acute liver failure (N-acetylcysteine).
